sql.processStepEvent.actionLogicString: with logic as ( select case when ot.operation_type is not null then ot.operation_type when obt.id in (1, 2, 3, 4) then concat(upper(obt.object_type), ': ', case when ps.process_step_name is not null then concat(ps.process_step_name, ': ') end, cfg.group_name, ' - ', cf.field_name, ' ', opt.operator_type, ' ', coalesce(psr.requirement_value, cf.custom_field_sql_key, '> Option: ', custom_sql_option_id) end) when psr.company_function_id is not null then concat('FUNCTION: ', company_function_name, ' ', opt.operator_type, ' ', coalesce(psr.requirement_value, dtr.data_type_value)) when process_step_requirement_type_id = 7 then concat('Company PS Status of ', ref_ps.process_step_name, ' in (', array_to_string( array(select process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') when process_step_requirement_type_id = 8 then concat('ROOT PS Status of process_step_requirement_type_id = 9 then concat('Company Project Status in (', array_to_string(array(select project_status_type from flow.company_project_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') when process_step_requirement_type_id = 10 then concat('ROOT Project Status in (', array_to_string(array(select project_status_type from flow.project_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') when process_step_requirement_type_id = 11 then concat('Company Event Status in (', array_to_string(array(select event_status_type from flow.company_event_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') end as value from flow.process_step_event_logic psl left join flow.operation_type ot on psl.operation_type_id = ot.id left join flow.process_step_event_requirement psr on psl.process_step_event_requirement_id = psr.id left join flow.operator_type opt on psr.operator_type_id = opt.id left join flow.data_type_requirement dtr on psr.data_type_requirement_id = dtr.id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on psr.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id left join cfn.id left join flow.process_step ref_ps on ref_ps.id = psr.reference_process_step_id where psl.process_step_event_action_id = :actionId and psl.archived is false order by psl.sql_order ) select
